description: The >>FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive - the second leg of Annex E.2 item 21, on the identical window and the identical derivation as flag-85-directive-window: introduced with the §2023:7.3 facility in COBOL-2002, classified obsolete by the 2014 standard, REMOVED in COBOL-2023. Its operand syntax is the 2002 and 2014 texts' (§2002:7.2.12.1), diagnosed and acted on by FlagDirectiveProcessor + FlagConformancePass (kb/Work PB5600); the row gates the directive WORD by edition. Below 2002 COBOL0900, at 2023 COBOL0902, at 2014 the COBOL0903 obsolete warning. (VCR row 28's third and fourth legs, Standard Arithmetic and MOVE QUOTE, were already rowed.)
citation: Annex E.2 item 21 (removed in 2023, classified obsolete by the previous standard); the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2002:7.2.12.1 general format (ON or OFF) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622. The 2023 text carries no clause (Annex E.2 item 21 removed the directive); the 2002 and 2014 texts print the format.

vcr: VCR row 28 (Annex E.2 item 21 removal) + the §2023:7.3 facility's 2002 introduction
source:
>>FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC STANDARD-BINARY
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725FN.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.

directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division
